capabilities: Render quiz JSON code blocks as interactive quizzes with single, multiple, true/false and fill-blank questions
Grade answers instantly with explanations and per-session first-try accuracy
Persist every attempt per question and quiz session in local data.json
Index all quiz blocks in the vault in a review panel with topic hierarchy and search
Visualize first-try accuracy, question-type distribution and weekly answering trends
extras: README is written in Chinese; the manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. It stores progress in data.json and auto-migrates legacy single-choice records, though per-attempt history from the old format cannot be recovered.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to run graded, interactive quizzes stored in notes or to keep a history of answer attempts across sessions.
summary: Quiz renderer that turns Markdown quiz JSON code blocks into interactive single-choice, multiple-choice, true/false and fill-blank quizzes with local attempt tracking.
